scientific_evidence.question: Resolving quantum gravity here means articulating the documented mathematical solution. Do not substitute an experimental-confirmation demand. Retain each statement's hypotheses and status.

execution_guide.cost_rule: Use actual model-specific usage and context size, not token price alone. Unknown cost/quality is unknown, not zero or best. Prefer the cheapest eligible option that meets the task; improve using recorded acceptance outcomes.
execution_guide.execution: Current delegation is bounded and sequential, not concurrent execution. No automatic retry/fallback after an uncertain send.

image.pricing: Both: USD5/M text input, USD8/M image input, USD30/M image output, standard processing. Equal rates do not imply equal cost per image.
